## 🛡️ Aviatrix Security — Distributed Cloud Firewall in Microsoft Sentinel
Live telemetry from the Aviatrix fabric: policy enforcement, threat detection, traffic, and gateway health.

parameters.name: Gateway
parameters.label: Gateway
parameters.query: union (AviatrixGwSysStats_CL | distinct gateway), (AviatrixNetworkSession_CL | distinct DvcHostname | project gateway=DvcHostname), (AviatrixWebSession_CL | distinct DvcHostname | project gateway=DvcHostname) | where isnotempty(gateway) | distinct gateway | union (print gateway='All') | order by gateway asc

content.query: union (AviatrixNetworkSession_CL | where DvcAction in ('Deny','Drop') | summarize Value=count() | extend Metric='Blocked Sessions'), (AviatrixIDS_CL | summarize Value=count() | extend Metric='IDS Alerts'), (AviatrixWebSession_CL | where isnotempty(DstFqdn) | summarize Value=dcount(DstFqdn) | extend Metric='Unique Domains'), (AviatrixGwSysStats_CL | summarize Value=dcount(gateway) | extend Metric='Active Gateways') | project Metric, Value
content.title: Security posture

content.query: union (AviatrixIDS_CL | extend Kind='IDS', Detail=ThreatName, Sev=toint(ThreatRiskLevel) | project TimeGenerated, Kind, Sev, SrcIpAddr, DstIpAddr, Detail), (AviatrixNetworkSession_CL | where DvcAction in ('Deny','Drop') | extend Kind='DCF Deny', Detail=strcat(NetworkProtocol,' ',tostring(DstPortNumber)), Sev=2 | project TimeGenerated, Kind, Sev, SrcIpAddr, DstIpAddr, Detail), (AviatrixWebSession_CL | where DvcAction in ('Deny','Drop') | extend Kind='DCF Deny (L7)', Detail=coalesce(DstFqdn, mitm_sni_hostname), Sev=2 | project TimeGenerated, Kind, Sev, SrcIpAddr, DstIpAddr, Detail) | sort by TimeGenerated desc | take 50
content.title: Live threat feed

content.query: union (AviatrixNetworkSession_CL | where ('{Gateway}'=='All' or DvcHostname=='{Gateway}') | project SrcIpAddr, DstIpAddr), (AviatrixWebSession_CL | where ('{Gateway}'=='All' or DvcHostname=='{Gateway}') | project SrcIpAddr, DstIpAddr) | summarize Sessions=count(), Dests=dcount(DstIpAddr) by SrcIpAddr | top 10 by Sessions desc
content.title: Top talkers

content.query: AviatrixWebSession_CL | where ('{Gateway}'=='All' or DvcHostname=='{Gateway}') | extend Domain=coalesce(DstFqdn, mitm_sni_hostname) | where isnotempty(Domain) | summarize Hits=count() by Domain | top 10 by Hits desc
content.title: Top accessed domains

content.query: union (AviatrixNetworkSession_CL | where ('{Gateway}'=='All' or DvcHostname=='{Gateway}') | project DvcAction), (AviatrixWebSession_CL | where ('{Gateway}'=='All' or DvcHostname=='{Gateway}') | project DvcAction) | extend Verdict=iff(DvcAction in ('Deny','Drop'),'Block','Allow') | summarize Count=count() by Verdict
content.title: Allow vs Block

content.query: union (AviatrixNetworkSession_CL | project SrcIpAddr, DstIpAddr), (AviatrixWebSession_CL | project SrcIpAddr, DstIpAddr) | extend SrcPriv=(SrcIpAddr matches regex @'^(10\.|172\.(1[6-9]|2[0-9]|3[01])\.|192\.168\.|100\.6[4-9]\.)'), DstPriv=(DstIpAddr matches regex @'^(10\.|172\.(1[6-9]|2[0-9]|3[01])\.|192\.168\.|100\.6[4-9]\.)') | extend Direction=case(SrcPriv and DstPriv,'East-West',SrcPriv and not(DstPriv),'Egress','Ingress') | summarize Count=count() by Direction
content.title: Traffic direction

content.query: union (AviatrixNetworkSession_CL | project enforced), (AviatrixWebSession_CL | project enforced) | extend Mode=iff(tobool(enforced),'Enforced','Monitor') | summarize Count=count() by Mode
content.title: Enforced vs Monitor

content.query: union (AviatrixNetworkSession_CL | where ('{Gateway}'=='All' or DvcHostname=='{Gateway}') | project TimeGenerated, DvcAction), (AviatrixWebSession_CL | where ('{Gateway}'=='All' or DvcHostname=='{Gateway}') | project TimeGenerated, DvcAction) | extend Verdict=iff(DvcAction in ('Deny','Drop'),'Block','Allow') | summarize Count=count() by bin(TimeGenerated,5m), Verdict
content.title: Policy activity over time

content.query: AviatrixWebSession_CL | where DvcAction in ('Deny','Drop') | extend Domain=coalesce(DstFqdn, mitm_sni_hostname) | where isnotempty(Domain) | summarize Blocks=count(), Sources=dcount(SrcIpAddr) by Domain | top 15 by Blocks desc
content.title: Top blocked domains

content.query: union (AviatrixNetworkSession_CL | project NetworkRuleName, DvcAction, SrcIpAddr), (AviatrixWebSession_CL | project NetworkRuleName, DvcAction, SrcIpAddr) | where isnotempty(NetworkRuleName) | summarize Hits=count(), Blocks=countif(DvcAction in ('Deny','Drop')), Sources=dcount(SrcIpAddr) by NetworkRuleName | extend BlockRatePct=round(100.0*Blocks/Hits,1) | top 15 by Hits desc
content.title: Top policies

content.query: union (AviatrixNetworkSession_CL | where DvcAction in ('Deny','Drop') | where ('{Gateway}'=='All' or DvcHostname=='{Gateway}') | project TimeGenerated, SrcIpAddr, DstIpAddr, DstPortNumber, NetworkProtocol, NetworkRuleName), (AviatrixWebSession_CL | where DvcAction in ('Deny','Drop') | where ('{Gateway}'=='All' or DvcHostname=='{Gateway}') | extend NetworkRuleName=coalesce(NetworkRuleName, mitm_sni_hostname) | project TimeGenerated, SrcIpAddr, DstIpAddr, DstPortNumber, NetworkProtocol, NetworkRuleName) | sort by TimeGenerated desc | take 50
content.title: Denied flows

content.query: AviatrixIDS_CL | extend Sev=case(toint(ThreatRiskLevel)==1,'1-Critical',toint(ThreatRiskLevel)==2,'2-High',toint(ThreatRiskLevel)==3,'3-Medium','4-Low') | summarize Count=count() by bin(TimeGenerated,5m), Sev
content.title: Alert timeline by severity

content.query: AviatrixIDS_CL | where isnotempty(ThreatCategory) | summarize Count=count() by ThreatCategory | top 10 by Count desc
content.title: Alert categories

content.query: AviatrixIDS_CL | summarize Alerts=count(), Sources=dcount(SrcIpAddr), Targets=dcount(DstIpAddr) by ThreatName, ThreatId, ThreatRiskLevel | top 20 by Alerts desc
content.title: Top signatures

content.query: AviatrixIDS_CL | summarize Alerts=count(), Signatures=dcount(ThreatName), Targets=dcount(DstIpAddr) by SrcIpAddr | top 20 by Alerts desc
content.title: Source investigation

content.query: union (AviatrixNetworkSession_CL | where ('{Gateway}'=='All' or DvcHostname=='{Gateway}') | project TimeGenerated, DvcAction), (AviatrixWebSession_CL | where ('{Gateway}'=='All' or DvcHostname=='{Gateway}') | project TimeGenerated, DvcAction) | extend Verdict=iff(DvcAction in ('Deny','Drop'),'Block','Allow') | summarize Sessions=count() by bin(TimeGenerated,5m), Verdict
content.title: Traffic over time (sessions)

content.query: union (AviatrixNetworkSession_CL | where ('{Gateway}'=='All' or DvcHostname=='{Gateway}') | project SrcIpAddr, DstIpAddr, DstPortNumber, NetworkProtocol, DvcAction), (AviatrixWebSession_CL | where ('{Gateway}'=='All' or DvcHostname=='{Gateway}') | project SrcIpAddr, DstIpAddr, DstPortNumber, NetworkProtocol, DvcAction) | summarize Sessions=count() by SrcIpAddr, DstIpAddr, DstPortNumber, NetworkProtocol, DvcAction | top 50 by Sessions desc
content.title: Source → destination flows

content.query: union (AviatrixNetworkSession_CL | project SrcIpAddr, DstIpAddr), (AviatrixWebSession_CL | project SrcIpAddr, DstIpAddr) | summarize Sessions=count(), Dests=dcount(DstIpAddr) by SrcIpAddr | top 15 by Sessions desc
content.title: Top sources

content.query: union (AviatrixNetworkSession_CL | project DstPortNumber), (AviatrixWebSession_CL | project DstPortNumber) | summarize Count=count() by DstPortNumber | top 15 by Count desc
content.title: Port distribution

content.query: AviatrixWebSession_CL | where ('{Gateway}'=='All' or DvcHostname=='{Gateway}') | extend Domain=coalesce(DstFqdn, mitm_sni_hostname), Verdict=iff(DvcAction in ('Deny','Drop'),'Block','Allow') | where isnotempty(Domain) | summarize Hits=count() by Domain | top 20 by Hits desc
content.title: Top domains by hits (L7 / SNI)

content.query: AviatrixWebSession_CL | where ('{Gateway}'=='All' or DvcHostname=='{Gateway}') | extend Domain=coalesce(DstFqdn, mitm_sni_hostname), Verdict=iff(DvcAction in ('Deny','Drop'),'Block','Allow') | where isnotempty(Domain) | summarize Hits=count(), Sources=dcount(SrcIpAddr), Gateways=dcount(DvcHostname), LastSeen=max(TimeGenerated) by Domain, Verdict | top 30 by Hits desc
content.title: Domain detail (hits, sources, gateways, last seen)

content.query: AviatrixGwSysStats_CL | where ('{Gateway}'=='All' or gateway=='{Gateway}') | summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated,*) by gateway | extend CpuPct=round(100.0-todouble(cpu_idle),1), MemPct=round(100.0*(todouble(memory_total)-todouble(memory_available))/todouble(memory_total),1), DiskPct=round(100.0*(todouble(disk_total)-todouble(disk_free))/todouble(disk_total),1) | extend Status=case(CpuPct>90 or MemPct>90 or DiskPct>90,'Critical',CpuPct>75 or MemPct>75 or DiskPct>75,'Warning','Healthy') | project gateway, Status, CpuPct, MemPct, DiskPct
content.title: Gateway status

content.query: AviatrixGwSysStats_CL | where ('{Gateway}'=='All' or gateway=='{Gateway}') | summarize CpuPct=avg(100.0-todouble(cpu_idle)) by bin(TimeGenerated,5m), gateway
content.title: CPU utilization

content.query: AviatrixGwSysStats_CL | where ('{Gateway}'=='All' or gateway=='{Gateway}') | summarize MemPct=avg(100.0*(todouble(memory_total)-todouble(memory_available))/todouble(memory_total)) by bin(TimeGenerated,5m), gateway
content.title: Memory utilization

content.query: AviatrixGwNetStats_CL | where ('{Gateway}'=='All' or gateway=='{Gateway}') | summarize RxRate=avg(todouble(total_rx_rate)), TxRate=avg(todouble(total_tx_rate)) by bin(TimeGenerated,5m), gateway
content.title: Network throughput (Rx/Tx rate)
